intent_leaves.intent: Inspector selects a work date; useDailyReport fetches or lazily creates a daily_reports row (status='draft'). buildDailyReportSnapshot groups annotations by pay_item_id, applies unit conversion, and joins prior_cumulative from v_approved_pay_item_quantities. The result is returned as SnapshotItem[] and displayed as a live preview without persisting.
key_facts: Row is only written on submit, not on preview render.
If no row exists yet, insert with status='draft' and the snapshot payload.
previewQuery is disabled once status='approved' to avoid unnecessary fetches.

intent_leaves.intent: On submit: (1) buildDailyReportSnapshot is called fresh to produce the frozen snapshot; (2) if no row exists it is inserted as draft+snapshot then immediately updated to submitted; (3) if a rejected/submitted row already exists it is first reset to draft+snapshot, then flipped to submitted; (4) a single update sets status='submitted'. The frozen snapshot JSONB is the source of truth for RE review.
key_facts: Two sequential updates (draft→snapshot, then →submitted) instead of a single atomic upsert — a partial failure leaves status='draft' with the new snapshot.
Empty snapshots (zero annotations) are intentionally allowed.
submitted_at is not explicitly set client-side; expected to be set by DB default or trigger.

intent_leaves.intent: After submit, previewQuery continues running. isStale compares frozen snapshot vs live preview: length mismatch or any per-item delta_quantity diff > 0.005 triggers stale=true. Inspector sees an 'out of date' alert with a Resubmit button, which calls submit() again and replaces the snapshot atomically.
key_facts: Comparison is quantity-only — unit/name changes do not flag stale.
Resubmit path reuses the same submit mutation; it resets to draft then re-submits.

intent_leaves.intent: RE calls useApproveReport(reportId) which issues update({status:'approved'}) on daily_reports. Approved rows are excluded from the submitted queue and their snapshot.delta_quantity values become visible through v_approved_pay_item_quantities to downstream quantity-to-payment rollups. useBulkApproveReports handles multiple IDs in a single .in() update.
key_facts: approved_by and approved_at are NOT set client-side — no code in useApproveReport populates these columns.
Role enforcement is client-only (isResidentEngineer check in UI); no server-side RLS prevents any authenticated user from approving.
Bulk approve uses a single .in(ids) update, correct for atomicity.

intent_leaves.intent: RE opens ReRejectDialog which enforces a non-empty reason before calling useRejectReport. The mutation: (1) updates daily_reports with status='rejected' and reject_reason; (2) auto-inserts a daily_report_comments row with body='Rejected: <reason>' attributed to the RE user. The inspector sees the rejection reason on their DailyReport page.
key_facts: rejected_at and rejected_by columns are NOT set client-side in the reject mutation; only status and reject_reason are written.
Comment insert is fire-and-forget after the main update — failure is swallowed.
No push notification is sent to the inspector at rejection time.

intent_leaves.intent: Inspector calls reopen() on a rejected report. Mutation issues update({status:'draft'}) only. Inspector can then edit annotations and resubmit.
key_facts: BUG: rejected_at and rejected_by are NOT cleared on reopen, leaving stale timestamps visible in audit trails.
reject_reason is also not cleared — could confuse downstream readers if they check reason without checking status.
Snapshot is not refreshed on reopen; the frozen snapshot remains until the next submit.

intent_leaves.intent: useReportArchives queries the daily_report_snapshots table (cast as `any` due to missing generated types) and returns historical snapshots with archived_at, archived_reason, and reject_reason. The RE review card renders a diff column comparing current snapshot to prior archive entries.
key_facts: Table daily_report_snapshots is absent from generated Supabase types — queried with `from('daily_report_snapshots' as any)`.
If the table does not exist in production the query silently returns [] with no user-facing error.
No client code explicitly writes to daily_report_snapshots — archival is expected to happen via DB trigger or the (undocumented) daily_reports_status_side_effects function.

intent_leaves.intent: The daily_reports_status_side_effects DB function is referenced in the stream spec as the notification seam but is NOT present in any migration file found in supabase/migrations/. The send-push edge function exists and accepts {user_id, title, body} with service-role auth, dispatching FCM push via device_tokens table. However, no wiring between daily_report status changes and send-push calls exists in the current codebase.
key_facts: send-push requires FCM_SERVER_KEY env var; returns {ok:true,skipped:true} if missing.
DB trigger / daily_reports_status_side_effects function: NOT FOUND in migrations — either not yet implemented or lives outside version-controlled migrations.
Inspector receives no real-time signal on RE approve or reject; React Query invalidation only affects the RE's own cache.
Gap: no subscribe/webhook path from Supabase Realtime or DB trigger to push inspector notifications on status transitions.

intent_leaves.intent: Four-state FSM: draft → submitted (inspector submit) → approved (RE approve) or rejected (RE reject) → draft (inspector reopen). Approved is a terminal state from the inspector's perspective; no reopen path exists for approved reports.
Consolidated debt items requiring action before production.

items.description: daily_report_snapshots missing from generated types — archive panel silently broken if table absent.
items.fix: Add table to schema, regenerate types, remove `as any` cast.

items.description: No server-side RLS on approve/reject — any authenticated user can approve reports.
items.fix: Add RLS policy: UPDATE on daily_reports WHERE new.status IN ('approved','rejected') requires role='resident_engineer' via JWT claim or profiles lookup.

items.description: rejected_at / rejected_by not cleared on reopen; approved_by / approved_at not set on approve; rejected_by / rejected_at not set on reject.
items.fix: Extend client mutations or implement daily_reports_status_side_effects DB trigger to maintain all audit timestamp/actor columns.

items.description: No push notification to inspector on RE decision.
items.fix: Implement daily_reports_status_side_effects as a DB trigger (or pg_net call) that invokes send-push edge function with the inspector's user_id when status changes to approved or rejected.

items.description: submit() uses two sequential updates (draft then submitted) — partial failure risk.
items.fix: Consolidate into a single upsert or wrap in a DB RPC.
